customer_message: @AppleSupport what is this “other” and how do I delete it? It seems to use up a lot of space. #iphone https://t.co/XX9BHoBOiC
draft_reply:
Hi @AppleSupport, thanks for reaching out!  

“Other” storage is made up of items that iOS can’t place into the standard categories—things like system files, caches, logs, Siri data, software updates, and temporary files. It can grow over time, but you can often shrink it by:

* Clearing Safari’s cache (Settings → Safari → Clear History and Website Data)  
* Deleting old message attachments or large iMessage threads  
* Offloading or deleting apps you no longer use (Settings → General → iPhone Storage)  
* Restarting your iPhone, which can clear some temporary files  

For a detailed walk‑through of what “Other” includes and additional steps to free up space, please see this support article: https://t.co/0yFHFRYSnX.  

Hope this helps! Let us know if you have any other questions.
action_reason: Confidence and evidence quality are sufficient.
